content_sections.heading: NITTTR Kolkata Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Software Developer and 1 for Technician (Computer Hardware and Networking).

content_sections.heading: NITTTR Kolkata Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Software Developer: B.E./ B. Tech. in CSE/ IT or equivalent or M. Tech in CSE/ IT or MCA or equivalent with a minimum of 1 year of working experience in web developing. Technician (Computer Hardware and Networking): Diploma in CSE/ IT or B. Tech in CSE/ IT with a minimum of 1 year of working experience in the computer field.

content_sections.heading: NITTTR Kolkata Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

content_sections.heading: NITTTR Kolkata Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening based on information furnished in the online application form Selection process may involve shortlisting based on academic performance, relevant experience, or other objective criteria. Verification of eligibility, qualifications, experience, and other credentials.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NITTTR Kolkata to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NITTTR Kolkata recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications for the NITTTR Kolkata recruitment is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Software Developer and Technician posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by NITTTR Kolkata. One vacancy is for the post of Software Developer and the other is for the Technician (Computer Hardware and Networking) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Software Developer position?
faq.answer: For the Software Developer post, candidates must possess a B.E./B. Tech. in CSE/IT or equivalent, or an M. Tech in CSE/IT, or an MCA or equivalent degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum experience required for the Technician post?
faq.answer: The Technician (Computer Hardware and Networking) position requires a minimum of 1 year of working experience in the computer field. Candidates should have a Diploma in CSE/IT or B. Tech in CSE/IT.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the NITTTR Kolkata recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Software Developer and Technician posts is not more than 35 years as on the closing date of application submission.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Software Developer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Software Developer post will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for the NITTTR Kolkata recruitment through the online mode only. The application link will be available on the official website.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for NITTTR Kolkata recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve screening based on the information provided in the online application form. Shortlisting may be done based on academic performance, experience, or other criteria, followed by verification of documents.
